items.summary: History educators around the world have expressed concerns about declining history enrollments in schools and universities over the past few decades.

items.title: Scientists find why the liver may not heal even after you stop drinking
items.summary: Alcohol-related liver disease may trap damaged liver cells in a regenerative limbo, preventing the organ from rebuilding itself even after drinking stops. Researchers linked the problem to inflammation-driven RNA errors and identified a pathway that could potentially be targeted to restore liver rep
